description: This file defines FastAPI route endpoints for retrieving activity feeds related to projects and tasks within a project management system. It includes two API endpoints that utilize dependencies for database access and user authentication, returning activity events as serialized output.

methods.name: List[ActivityOut] project_activity_endpoint( project_id: int, limit: int = 50, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch activity log for a project, returning a list of ActivityOut objects.

methods.name: List[ActivityOut] task_activity_endpoint( project_id: int, task_id: int, limit: int = 50, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch activity log for a task within a project, returning a list of ActivityOut objects.
